notes: 4 photos: 1 and 4 are drink-only lists (cocktails/beer/wine, frozen cocktails/wine) and were skipped. Photos 2 and 3 are two different food menus with overlapping item names (Nachos, TJ Dog, Smashburger) but different prices/ingredients - both plausibly belong to this pool-bar business (photo 3 is explicitly branded 'Shallow End Grill'), so items from both are included rather than merged/deduped. Plain non-alcoholic beverage line items (Pepsi products, Redbull, Tropicana juices, bottled water) were skipped as not dishes.
